title: Expose an algebraic normal form before arithmetic automation
obstacle: Small arithmetic goals are obstructed by function wrappers, casts or quotient forms.
procedure: Unfold only the interface wrappers that prevent matching.
Normalize casts, finite sums and field expressions before ring/linear arithmetic.
verification: Kernel-check each normal-form equality and retain denominator hypotheses.
positive_example: Finite Gauss sums and normalized coefficient calculations share explicit scalar algebra.
negative_example: field_simp cannot justify division by a denominator that may vanish.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.
